Subject: DPA execution + auditor evidence request

Hi Markus / Marissa —

Thanks for the productive demo last week. Procurement is ready to move forward but we need to finalize the Data Processing Agreement and get evidence for a quick internal security review. Specifically MedTech Legal is asking for:

- Signed DPA (DocuSign or AdobeSign)
- Current subprocessor inventory and onboarding timeline
- SOC 2 Type II summary report or at least the summary page and scope
- High-level penetration test executive summary (redacted OK)

Can you confirm a target window for signature and when the evidence above can be shared? Procurement would like to close before month-end.

Also please confirm whether Redwood accepts audit rights as drafted in clause 6.2 and whether cross-border transfers are covered by SCCs / adequacy mechanism.

Claire Martin
Head of IT Procurement — MedTech Inc
claire@medtech-ops.com

(Attachment: initial-contract-terms.pdf referenced by procurement)"

Subject: Re: DPA execution + auditor evidence request

Hi Claire —

Thanks for the clear list. A few clarifications from legal:

1) Audit rights: Redwood is comfortable with evidence-based audit workouts for material customers. We generally provide: SOC 2 Type II report (summary and bridge letter), penetration test executive summary, and a right to request on-site audit via an agreed third-party with reasonable notice and scoping.

Proposed wording (suggested compromise):
- "Customer may request supplemental audit evidence up to once annually; requests must be limited in scope to Redwood's processing controls relevant to the Service, and Redwood may satisfy requests through existing compliance reports and third-party assessments."

2) Subprocessors: We'll provide a current inventory and an onboarding timeline. For any new subprocessor that will process Customer Personal Data, Redwood will notify 30 days (standard) or agree on an accelerated notice if needed for go-live.

3) Cross-border transfers: Redwood uses SCCs where applicable and maintains contractual and technical controls. If you require a data flow addendum referencing SCCs explicitly we can append that prior to signature.

I attached an updated redline (redlines-DPA-v2.docx) that narrows the audit clause and includes SCC language. Please review and let us know any mandatory Procurement edits.

Marissa Cole
Sr. Counsel, Contracts — Redwood Inference
marissa@redwood.com
(Attachment: redlines-DPA-v2.docx)

Hi Claire — following up with the evidence deliverables and some operational detail for Procurement:

- Subprocessor inventory: attached as subprocessors-2026-11.csv. It lists current subprocessors, data categories, and processing purposes. We highlighted the ones that handle sensitive data.
- SOC 2: attached SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf (summary + scope). Full report available under NDA; let us know if Procurement needs it and we'll route the request.
- Pen test: attached pen-test-exec-summary.txt (redacted executive summary).
- DocuSign: when you confirm the final DPA, we'll send an envelope. To speed signature, here is our standard envelope text for clause 6 (audit): "Customer may request evidence via Redwood's compliance portal and existing third-party reports. On-site audits will be subject to scope, notice, and approved third-party auditor selection."

Operational timeline we propose:
- 2026-11-13: MedTech to send any last mandatory redlines (procurement/legal).
- 2026-11-14: Redwood finalizes DPA and loads DocuSign envelope.
- 2026-11-15: Execution complete (target).

If MedTech needs SCCs appended rather than embedded language, we can provide a short addendum; that will not block signature if both parties agree.

Priya Natarajan
Head of Compliance — Redwood Inference
priya@redwood.com
(Attachments: subprocessors-2026-11.csv, SOC2-TypeII-summary.pdf, pen-test-exec-summary.txt)
